concepts.name: NDA effective date
justifications: Section 1.2 states that the Effective Date is 1 February 2027, distinct from the 29 January 2027 signing date.

concepts.name: NDA permitted purpose
predicted: evaluating a possible minority investment by the recipient in the discloser's marine sensor business under project glassfinch
gold: evaluating a possible minority investment by the recipient in the discloser's marine sensor business under project glassfinch.
values: Evaluating a possible minority investment by the Recipient in the Discloser's marine sensor business under Project Glassfinch
justifications: Section 1.2 defines the sole Permitted Purpose as evaluating a minority investment in the Discloser's marine sensor business under Project Glassfinch. Activities such as competing, product development, acquisitions and model training are excluded.

concepts.name: NDA disclosure window end
justifications: A valid termination notice delivered on 24 November 2027 closes the disclosure window effective 30 November 2027, which replaces the ordinary 31 January 2028 end date. No later instrument changes that notice.

concepts.name: NDA contractual forum
justifications: Section 1.4 states that the parties designate the courts of Oslo as their contractual forum, with Norwegian law governing.

concepts.name: NDA signatory entities
justifications: Section 1.1 identifies FjordSignal AS as registered in Norway and as the Discloser party to the Agreement.
Section 1.1 identifies Talus Ventures AB as registered in Sweden and as the Recipient party to the Agreement.

concepts.name: Protected assets at the April snapshot
justifications: LUMEN, SHORE, CEDAR and BASALT remain protected at the 7 April 2027 snapshot. ORACLE lacks protection then because its confirmation was late and acceptance came on 8 April, and MICA is wholly excluded by independent development.

concepts.name: ORACLE timely confirmation deadline
justifications: Five Business Days after the oral call on Thursday 25 March 2027, excluding 26 and 29 March, ends at 17:00 UTC on 5 April 2027. Counting excludes the trigger day and starts from the first eligible day.

concepts.name: ORACLE protection timeline
predicted: protection for oracle is not continuous. identified oral information was provisionally protected from the 25 march 2027 call until the confirmation deadline of 5 april 2027 at 17:00 utc, after which the late confirmation (sent 5 april 16:58, arrived 6 april 09:05) left a gap. protection was restored prospectively only from the recipient's written acceptance on 8 april 2027 at 10:00 utc, without covering the intervening gap; delivery at arrival, not sending, determined timeliness.
gold: oracle is provisionally protected from the 25 march oral disclosure until 5 april 2027 at 17:00 utc. confirmation sent before that deadline arrived late on 6 april at 09:05, so protection lapses after the deadline. it resumes prospectively when the recipient expressly accepts on 8 april at 10:00 utc; the gap is not cured retroactively.
values: Protection for ORACLE is not continuous. Identified oral information was provisionally protected from the 25 March 2027 call until the confirmation deadline of 5 April 2027 at 17:00 UTC, after which the late confirmation (sent 5 April 16:58, arrived 6 April 09:05) left a gap. Protection was restored prospectively only from the Recipient's written acceptance on 8 April 2027 at 10:00 UTC, without covering the intervening gap; delivery at arrival, not sending, determined timeliness.
justifications: The protection periods, gap and deadline follow from the oral-information rule and the Annex A timeline. Timeliness turns on delivery at mailbox arrival rather than on sending.

concepts.name: Entire SHORE package excluded by prior possession
justifications: The prior-possession evidence covers only the older S-17 module, which is incorporated in S-92. S-92 also contains a new non-public branching map and thresholds with no record of prior possession, so the entire package is not excluded.

concepts.name: CEDAR end of protection
justifications: The Discloser's lawful, independent public release of the entire CEDAR schedule on 15 June 2027 establishes the public-information exclusion for all of it, ending protection from that date. This overrides the otherwise longer duration to 1 February 2030 and the September resend does not restart protection.

concepts.name: People permitted LUMEN access at the September snapshot
justifications: Elin, Marek and Oskar each meet their applicable undertaking or duty, security check, clean-room approval and eligibility conditions effective by the 15 September 2027 snapshot. Nora's undertaking only took effect on 16 September, Pia lacks an executed competitor consent, and Ravi is employed by a non-Affiliate entity.

concepts.name: Talus Research qualifying voting percentage
justifications: The Recipient's directly held 48 percent of general shareholder votes plus the 4 percent covered by an irrevocable proxy in effect at the snapshot totals 52 percent, while the revocable 6 percent is excluded.

concepts.name: Marek earliest authorised LUMEN access
justifications: Marek's clean-room approval becomes effective on 14 September, which is the latest of his undertaking (8 September), security check (10 September) and the Affiliate voting status (from 1 September). Access therefore cannot begin before 14 September 2027.

concepts.name: Executed competitor consent date for Pia
Q-27 notice deadline date
justifications: The prohibition was lifted at 11:20 on 5 July 2027, so six continuous hours later is 17:20 that day, which is earlier than the 12:00 production time on 6 July 2027. Under the initially prohibited notice rule, the deadline is therefore 5 July 2027.

concepts.name: Q-27 notice lateness in minutes
justifications: The notice reached the designated mailbox at 17:55 on 5 July 2027, against a deadline of 17:20 that day, which is 35 minutes late. Compelled-disclosure notices are measured at actual arrival, so the after-hours deferral does not apply.

concepts.name: Q-27 permitted production units
justifications: The final binding narrowing order requires the full first unit and only the non-privileged subsection of the third unit, with the other units withdrawn or privileged. The portal production comprised only those same two units.

concepts.name: WORK-1 deletion deadline
justifications: The return request arrived on 22 November 2027, before the earlier termination trigger, so the ten-Business-Day period runs from that date, skipping the excluded 25 and 26 November. Restoring WORK-1 on 1 December does not restart the deadline.

concepts.name: BK-1 deletion deadline
justifications: The backup may remain only until the earlier of its scheduled overwrite on 30 December 2027 and 45 calendar days after the 22 November trigger, which is 6 January 2028. Restoration does not restart either clock.

concepts.name: Artifacts permitted retention at the December snapshot
justifications: ARCH-1 is the counsel-held archival copy permitted under the archival exception, BK-1 is an immutable backup still within its retention window at the snapshot, and HOLD-1 is covered by a binding preservation order. WORK-1 and NOTE-1 have no permitted exception at the snapshot.

concepts.name: NOTE-1 model training permitted as residual knowledge
justifications: Training or evaluating a model with Confidential Information requires a separate signed licence, and residual-knowledge permission excludes recorded notes and quantitative parameters. NOTE-1 consists of recorded LUMEN parameters and no licence or consent covers its use for training.
